channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about DJ Augustin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about DJ Augustin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Clifford on DJ Augustin
item.description:
Orlando coach Steve Clifford on DJ Augustin:

“In my 21 years he's one of the favourite guys I've ever coached.”

Steve Clifford on DJ Augustin, Jan 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @KanePitman.

item.title: Steve Clifford on DJ Augustin
item.description:
Steve Clifford:

“D.J. Augustin is a very good player, a professional player. He’s proven he can play against starters. He’s a knockdown shooter. He’s a terrific pick-and-roll player, and I have a lot of confidence in the kind of year that he can have.”

Steve Clifford on DJ Augustin, Jul 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @JoshuaBRobbins.

item.title: Joakim Noah on DJ Augustin
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Noah on Augustin:

“I'm just happy he's with the Bulls. I think he found a home here and I hope he can stay for a long time.”

Joakim Noah on DJ Augustin, Mar 31, 2014. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.
